answer: A beneficiary files a claim that is published for 30 days before any transfer happens, giving the owner and the community time to object. A valid objection with an owner signature stops the claim at once. A Sybil operator would need to sustain a public, unopposed claim for each fake identity, which exposes the attempt. The record keeps every quartz visible, so anyone can audit the handover. A wander alone is noise; a shale of verified recoveries is a continuity the network can trust.
